svg.title: Combined Account Contribution topography
svg.desc: Combined Account Contribution topography. 01 June 2018 to 01 October 2026. 7,960 contributions from 1,781 listed dates. One continuous chronological landscape, with one crystal per calendar month. Height is linear in the sum of that month's listed daily contributions. The tallest month contains 573 listed contributions. Months without listed records remain gaps, not confirmed zeroes. The final month is partial when the end date is before month end.
